name: Master Angler
summary: Every Sunday, an angling contest seeks the greatest anglers. Bring Tastyfish from Stranglethorn’s coastal schools among the first fifty to be declared a Master Angler.

sections.title: Sunday’s Contest
sections.body: The contest is open each Sunday, and you can earn the title of Master Angler by bringing Tastyfish to the organizer among the first fifty people. The fish come from schools along the coasts of Stranglethorn, and they spoil quickly.

sections.title: A Second Offer
sections.body: If you arrive too late for the first fifty places, the organizer’s apprentice will still pay you for Tastyfish. The fish do not keep until the next Sunday.

faq.answer: The contest takes place every Sunday.
Tastyfish schools are found along the coasts of Stranglethorn.

faq.q: How do I become a Master Angler?
faq.answer: Bring Tastyfish to the contest organizer among the first fifty people.

faq.q: What if I arrive too late?
faq.answer: The organizer’s apprentice will pay you for Tastyfish if you are too late to be among the first fifty.

faq.q: Can I save Tastyfish for next week?
faq.answer: No. Tastyfish spoil quickly, so they cannot be saved for the next Sunday.
